summary: Assay worksheet for the KT12 protease analogue set run in human and rat liver microsomes and in cryopreserved hepatocytes at 1 µM. Matrix acceptance was recorded before the depletion values were released. Hepatocyte turnover picks up a clearance route that the microsomal screen does not show, which is why the shortlist was revisited.

rows: Liver microsomal stability (0.5 mg/mL protein, 1 µM); hepatocyte stability (0.5×10^6 cells/mL, 1 µM)
Final. Read with the paired readout (MV-2021-284 R1), not on its own.
